subject.title: [Bug]: Early abort response templates are not populated.

question: Should maintainers repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/45315 in place, replace it with a fresh current-main fix, or wait for the author to address the open review concerns?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the same-repo PR is already the linked implementation candidate, but the branch is unmerged, conflicting, and needs a choice about routed delivery and active model context handling.

options.title: Repair the linked PR

options.title: Replace with a fresh fix
